name: Global Logistics DC #6094 (Ambient & Cold Chain Operations)

vulnerabilities.title: Johnson Controls Frick Quantum HD Web Server Authentication Bypass
vulnerabilities.description: Improper authentication in the web service of the Frick Quantum HD compressor controller allows an attacker with network access to bypass credentials and modify temperature setpoints, discharge pressures, and ammonia compressor run parameters.
affected_components: Johnson Controls / Frick Quantum HD Compressor Controller

vulnerabilities.title: Modbus-TCP Stack Denial of Service and State Injection in Embedded Controller
vulnerabilities.description: Sending an invalid Modbus function code sequence over TCP port 502 triggers an unhandled null-pointer dereference causing the PLC communication module to lock up and drop watchdog heartbeats.
affected_components: Johnson Controls / Frick Quantum HD Compressor Controller

vulnerabilities.title: Rockwell Automation GuardLogix/ControlLogix CIP Explicit Message Buffer Overflow
vulnerabilities.description: A remote unauthenticated attacker can send crafted Common Industrial Protocol (CIP) packets to cause a buffer overflow, allowing arbitrary code execution or unhandled controller fault (Major Non-Recoverable Fault - MNFR) in Rockwell ControlLogix and GuardLogix controllers.

vulnerabilities.title: Windows Remote Desktop Protocol Elevation of Privilege on Engineering Workstations
vulnerabilities.description: An elevation of privilege vulnerability in Windows RDP client allows local low-privileged users to execute code as SYSTEM on unpatched engineering workstations.
affected_components: Dell / Rockwell Automation Studio 5000 / TIA Portal EWS

threat_scenarios.title: Exploit of CVE-2021-32955 on DC6094-AMMONIA-COMP-PLC-01 via Conduit
threat_scenarios.threat_actor: Opportunistic Cybercriminal or Malicious Insider (IEC 62443 SL-2 Profile)
threat_scenarios.threat_vector: Remote exploit via Modbus-TCP, EtherNet/IP, HTTP targeting Johnson Controls Frick Quantum HD Web Server Authentication Bypass
threat_scenarios.operational_impact_summary: Catastrophic hazard: Compromise of DC6094-AMMONIA-COMP-PLC-01 risks uncontrolled ammonia discharge, emergency plant evacuation, OSHA/EPA violation, and full cold-chain perishables destruction.
recommended_compensating_controls: Immediately sever uninspected/direct conduit bypass into zone; enforce traffic through L3.5 DMZ firewall.
Deploy Industrial Firewall Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) rule restricting 10.142.12.10 to authorized engineering workstation IPs only; block unauthorized firmware download function codes.
Configure Armis anomaly detection policy to alert on anomalous connection attempts to 10.142.12.10.
